purpose: Original game environment panoramas. Names match assets/*.png.

assets.name: harbor-night
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original panoramic background plate for the playable 2D side scrolling game IRON COAST, not a concept sheet or screenshot.
Primary request: A premium cinematic pixel-art industrial harbor at night, inspired by the atmospheric depth, disciplined composition and motivated lighting of REPLACED. Entirely original coastal shipbreaking setting with a subtle Istanbul industrial shoreline character, no recognizable commercial game locations or characters.
Composition: very wide panorama, 3:1 aspect ratio. Orthographic side-on horizon. Distant clustered shipyard buildings and one dry-docked cargo ship recede into blue petrol fog. An imposing rusted gantry occupies the upper left third, a distant crane silhouette and smokestack toward the right, warehouse windows glow muted amber. Sky is dark blue-grey, no bright sunset. Bottom 25 percent is a quiet continuous dark harbor water and low mist band, suitable behind moving characters; no foreground platform or floor, no characters. Leave middle/lower center spacious so gameplay silhouettes remain clear.
Style: meticulously clustered cinematic pixel art, designed to resolve at 480x272, visible controlled pixels and beautiful painterly light shapes, restrained texture, dramatic scale. Deep inky navy shadows, desaturated steel teal midtones, tiny warm sodium pools, local pale cyan industrial lamps, atmospheric perspective with far silhouettes low contrast. Wet metal, sparse pinpoints reflected in water. Highest visual intensity only around practical lamps, readable silhouettes.
Constraints: one continuous environment image, no sprite atlas, no labels, no UI, no lettering, no logo, no border, no characters, no close foreground objects, no dangling ropes or hanging decorations, no giant lens flares, no random streaks, no perspective road toward the horizon. Opaque full scene.
